display.name: LiteLLM
display.blurb: LLM inference through your own LiteLLM proxy. Routes sessions to the proxy's models and powers orchestrator-side titles and decisions; grantable to sessions for chat completions.

settings.name: api_host
settings.label: Proxy host

custom.label: Your proxy

settings.hint: Sessions and the orchestrator reach this host on port 443.
